knowledgeBaseArticle.title: How to Reset Your Password
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## Password Reset Guide

If you have forgotten your password or your account has been locked, follow these steps to regain access.

### Self-Service Password Reset

1. Go to the login page and click **"Forgot Password"**
2. Enter your company email address
3. Check your inbox for the reset link (valid for 30 minutes)
4. Click the link and set a new password
5. Password requirements: minimum 8 characters, at least one uppercase, one lowercase, and one number

### Contact IT Support

If self-service reset is unavailable:
- Submit an IT Support request under the **Account & Access** category
- An agent will verify your identity and reset your password
- New temporary credentials will be sent to your registered email

### Common Issues

- **Reset link expired**: Request a new one — links expire after 30 minutes
- **Didn't receive email**: Check spam/junk folder, or contact IT
- **Account locked**: Wait 15 minutes before retrying, or contact IT Support
knowledgeBaseArticle.excerpt: Step-by-step guide to resetting your company password via self-service or IT Support.

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: VPN Setup and Troubleshooting
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## VPN Configuration Guide

All remote workers must use the company VPN to access internal resources securely.

### Installing the VPN Client

1. Download the VPN client from the IT Downloads portal
2. Run the installer with default settings
3. When prompted, enter the server address: **vpn.citadelgroup.local**
4. Use your standard company credentials to authenticate

### Connecting to the VPN

1. Launch the VPN client
2. Select **"Corporate Network"** profile
3. Enter your username and password
4. Click **Connect**
5. Wait for the status to show **"Connected"**

### Troubleshooting

- **Connection timeout**: Check your internet connection, then try an alternate server (vpn2.citadelgroup.local)
- **Authentication failed**: Ensure you are using your current credentials — try resetting your password first
- **Slow performance**: Switch to the nearest server region in client settings
- **Client won't start**: Reinstall the client or run the repair tool from IT Downloads
knowledgeBaseArticle.excerpt: Configure and troubleshoot the company VPN for secure remote access.

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: Requesting New Software or Hardware
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## Software & Hardware Procurement

Need new software or equipment? Follow the procurement process below.

### Software Requests

1. Check the **Approved Software Catalog** first — if the software is listed, submit an IT request under **Software & Applications**
2. For software NOT in the catalog, submit an **IT Procurement** request with:
   - Software name and version
   - Business justification
   - Number of licenses needed
   - Approximate cost (if known)
3. The request will go through manager approval, then IT review

### Hardware Requests

1. Submit an **IT Procurement** request under the **Hardware & Devices** category
2. Include:
   - Type of hardware (laptop, monitor, peripherals)
   - Preferred specifications
   - Business justification
3. Standard hardware configurations are pre-approved — custom specs require additional review

### Turnaround Time

- **Standard software**: 1–2 business days after approval
- **New software (not in catalog)**: 5–10 business days
- **Standard hardware**: 3–5 business days after approval
- **Custom hardware**: 2–4 weeks
knowledgeBaseArticle.excerpt: How to request new software licenses or hardware through the procurement workflow.

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: Setting Up Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## MFA Setup Guide

MFA is mandatory for all company accounts. Set it up using Microsoft Authenticator or your preferred TOTP app.

### Step-by-Step Setup

1. Log in to the **Security Settings** portal
2. Click **"Enable MFA"**
3. Scan the QR code with Microsoft Authenticator (or Google Authenticator)
4. Enter the 6-digit verification code to confirm setup
5. Save your **recovery codes** in a secure location — you will need these if you lose access to your authenticator app

### Using MFA Daily

- You will be prompted for a verification code each time you log in
- Codes refresh every 30 seconds
- Some applications support "Remember this device for 30 days"

### Lost or Broken Device

1. Use one of your **recovery codes** to log in
2. Go to Security Settings → MFA → **"Reset MFA Device"**
3. Set up MFA on your new device
4. If you have no recovery codes, contact IT Support immediately
knowledgeBaseArticle.excerpt: Configure MFA on your account for enhanced security compliance.

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: Leave of Absence (LOA) Policy and Application
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## Leave of Absence Guide

Employees may apply for various types of leave through the HR Services portal.

### Leave Types

| Type | Entitlement | Approval |
|------|-------------|----------|
| Annual Leave | 14 days/year | Manager |
| Medical Leave | 14 days/year | Manager + MC |
| Emergency Leave | As needed | Manager |
| Unpaid Leave | Case-by-case | Manager + HR |

### How to Apply

1. Navigate to **HR Services** → **Leave Management**
2. Select the leave type
3. Fill in the dates and reason
4. Upload supporting documents (e.g., medical certificate)
5. Submit for manager approval

### Important Notes

- Annual leave must be applied **at least 3 days in advance**
- Medical leave requires a valid MC submitted within **24 hours**
- Leave balance can be checked on your HR dashboard
- Unconsumed annual leave may be carried forward (max 5 days) to the next year
knowledgeBaseArticle.excerpt: Understand leave types, entitlements, and how to apply through the HR portal.

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: Employee Benefits Overview
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## Benefits Package

Citadel Group offers a comprehensive benefits package for all permanent employees.

### Medical & Insurance

- **Group Hospitalization**: Full coverage under company panel hospitals
- **Outpatient**: RM 500/year reimbursement for non-panel visits
- **Dental**: RM 300/year for basic dental procedures

### Allowances

- **Transport**: RM 200/month for eligible roles
- **Meal**: RM 15/day for overtime beyond 7:30 PM
- **Communication**: RM 50/month mobile allowance

### Professional Development

- **Training Budget**: RM 3,000/year per employee
- **Certification Fee**: One professional certification per year (full reimbursement)
- **Conference Attendance**: Subject to manager approval

### How to Claim

Submit a request through **HR Services** → **Benefits & Claims** with supporting receipts. Claims are processed within 5 business days.
knowledgeBaseArticle.excerpt: Overview of medical, insurance, allowances, and professional development benefits.

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: How to Submit an Expense Claim
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## Expense Claim Process

Follow these steps to submit and track your business expense claims.

### Eligible Expenses

- Business travel (flights, hotels, transport)
- Client entertainment (meals, events)
- Office supplies (when procured independently)
- Training and certifications

### Submitting a Claim

1. Navigate to **Group Finance** → **Expense Claims**
2. Click **"New Claim"**
3. Fill in expense details:
   - Category and sub-category
   - Amount and currency
   - Date of expense
   - Business justification
4. Upload supporting receipts (PDF or image)
5. Submit for manager approval

### Approval Workflow

1. **Manager Review** — Verifies business justification
2. **Finance Review** — Validates receipts and compliance
3. **CFO Approval** — For claims above RM 5,000
4. **Payment Processing** — 5–7 business days after final approval

### Claim Limits

- Maximum per claim: RM 50,000
- Receipt required for any item above RM 50
- Claims must be submitted within **30 days** of the expense date
knowledgeBaseArticle.excerpt: Step-by-step guide for submitting and tracking business expense claims.

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: Purchase Requisition Guide
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## Purchase Requisition (PR) Process

All departmental purchases must go through the formal requisition workflow.

### When to Submit a PR

- Office equipment and furniture
- Software subscriptions and licenses
- Consulting and professional services
- Any purchase exceeding RM 500

### PR Workflow

1. **Submit Request** via Group Finance → Purchase Requisition
2. **Finance Acknowledgement** — Finance verifies budget allocation
3. **Finance Processing** — PO created and sent to vendor
4. **CFO Approval** — Required for purchases above RM 10,000
5. **Group CEO Approval** — Required for purchases above RM 50,000
6. **Payment** — Processed after goods/services received

### Required Information

- Item description and specifications
- Quantity and estimated unit cost
- Preferred vendor (if any)
- Budget code / cost center
- Expected delivery date
- Business justification

### Turnaround Time

- Under RM 10,000: 5–7 business days
- RM 10,000–50,000: 10–15 business days
- Above RM 50,000: 15–20 business days
knowledgeBaseArticle.excerpt: Complete guide for submitting and tracking purchase requisitions through approval workflow.

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: Connecting to a Shared Printer
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## Shared Printer Setup

Follow these steps to connect to the office network printers.

### Finding Available Printers

1. Go to **Start → Settings → Devices → Printers & Scanners**
2. Click **"Add a printer or scanner"**
3. Wait for the list to populate — office printers appear automatically on the company network
4. Select your floor/department printer and click **"Add device"**

### Printer Naming Convention

| Printer Name | Location |
|---|---|
| CWC-PRINT-L1 | Level 1, near reception |
| CWC-PRINT-L2A | Level 2, Finance wing |
| CWC-PRINT-L2B | Level 2, HR wing |
| CWC-PRINT-L3 | Level 3, IT & Admin |

### Common Issues

- **Printer not found**: Ensure you are on the corporate Wi-Fi or connected via LAN — VPN does not route printer traffic
- **Print job stuck**: Open the printer queue, cancel all jobs, and retry
- **Low toner / paper jam**: Submit an IT support request under **Hardware & Devices** — do not attempt to clear jams yourself on large printers

### Printing Tips

- Use **duplex (double-sided)** printing by default to conserve paper
- For confidential documents, use the **PIN Release** option — the document only prints when you enter your PIN at the printer
knowledgeBaseArticle.excerpt: How to connect to office network printers and resolve common printing issues.

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: Setting Up Company Email on Mobile
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## Company Email on Mobile Devices

Access your work email on your personal or company-issued mobile device using Microsoft Outlook.

### Prerequisites

- Install **Microsoft Outlook** from the App Store or Google Play
- Your company email credentials (username@citadelgroup.com)
- MFA must be set up on your account

### Setup Steps (iOS & Android)

1. Open **Outlook** and tap **Add Account**
2. Enter your company email address and tap **Continue**
3. On the Microsoft sign-in page, enter your password
4. Complete the **MFA prompt** (approve in Authenticator app)
5. Tap **"Allow"** when prompted to configure your device
6. Outlook will sync your emails, calendar, and contacts automatically

### Security Requirements

Connecting your device to company email enrolls it in **Intune Mobile Device Management**. This allows IT to:
- Enforce PIN/biometric lock on the device
- Remotely wipe company data (not personal data) if the device is lost
- Apply security policies (e.g., encryption)

### Personal Device Policy

- Only company data in the Outlook container is managed — personal apps and data are not affected
- If you leave the company, only the Outlook/company data container will be wiped
- If you do not want to enroll your personal device, request a company phone via IT Support
knowledgeBaseArticle.excerpt: Configure Microsoft Outlook on your mobile device to access company email securely.

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: New Employee IT Onboarding Checklist
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## IT Onboarding for New Employees

Welcome to Citadel Group! Complete the following steps within your first week to get fully set up.

### Day 1 Checklist

- [ ] Collect your laptop from IT (Level 3 IT Helpdesk)
- [ ] Log in with your temporary credentials provided by HR
- [ ] **Change your password immediately** on first login
- [ ] Set up **Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)** — see the MFA Setup Guide in this Knowledge Base
- [ ] Connect to **CWC-Corporate** Wi-Fi using your company credentials
- [ ] Set up **Microsoft Outlook** with your company email

### Week 1 Checklist

- [ ] Join the company **Microsoft Teams** workspace
- [ ] Set up company email on your mobile device (optional — see Mobile Email Guide)
- [ ] Bookmark key internal tools: CWC Portal, HR Self-Service, Finance Portal
- [ ] Review the **Acceptable Use Policy** (available in HR Knowledge Base)
- [ ] Install any role-specific software via the **IT Self-Service Catalog**

### Getting Help

For any IT issues during onboarding:
- Walk-in: Level 3 IT Helpdesk (8:30 AM – 5:30 PM, Mon–Fri)
- Submit a ticket: **IT Support → Account & Access** in this portal
- Emergency: Call IT Helpdesk at ext. 1234
knowledgeBaseArticle.excerpt: Complete IT setup checklist for new employees covering devices, accounts, and software.

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: Understanding Your Payslip
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## Payslip Guide

Your monthly payslip is available in the HR Self-Service portal by the 25th of each month.

### Accessing Your Payslip

1. Log in to the **HR Services** portal
2. Navigate to **My Profile → Payslips**
3. Select the month you want to view
4. Download as PDF for your records

### Payslip Breakdown

| Section | Description |
|---|---|
| Basic Salary | Your fixed monthly salary |
| Allowances | Transport, meal, communication, and role-specific allowances |
| Overtime | Calculated at 1.5x hourly rate for approved OT |
| EPF (Employee) | 11% of gross salary contributed by you |
| EPF (Employer) | 13% of gross salary contributed by Citadel |
| SOCSO | Social security contribution (varies by salary band) |
| EIS | Employment Insurance System deduction |
| PCB / Income Tax | Monthly tax deduction based on your tax bracket |
| **Net Pay** | **Amount deposited into your bank account** |

### Salary Payment Schedule

- Salaries are credited on the **last working day** of each month
- Overtime and claims approved before the 15th are included in the same month's payslip
- Disputes must be raised within **3 months** of the pay date

### Payslip Queries

Submit a request via **HR Services → Payroll & Compensation** with your query and the relevant payslip month attached.
knowledgeBaseArticle.excerpt: How to read and understand your monthly payslip including deductions and contributions.

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: Performance Review Process
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## Annual Performance Review Guide

Citadel Group conducts a formal performance review cycle twice a year. Here's what to expect and how to prepare.

### Review Cycle

| Review | Period | Completion Deadline |
|---|---|---|
| Mid-Year Review | Jan – Jun | 31 July |
| Year-End Review | Jul – Dec | 31 January |

### The Review Process

1. **Self-Assessment** — You complete a self-evaluation in the HR portal (opens 2 weeks before deadline)
2. **Manager Assessment** — Your direct manager rates your performance and adds comments
3. **Calibration** — Department heads align ratings across the team
4. **Feedback Discussion** — One-on-one session with your manager to review outcomes
5. **Final Sign-Off** — Both you and your manager acknowledge the review

### Rating Scale

| Rating | Description |
|---|---|
| 5 – Exceptional | Consistently exceeded all targets |
| 4 – Exceeds Expectations | Regularly exceeded most targets |
| 3 – Meets Expectations | Met all targets as expected |
| 2 – Needs Improvement | Partially met targets; development plan required |
| 1 – Unsatisfactory | Did not meet key targets |

### Tips for a Strong Self-Assessment

- Reference specific achievements with measurable outcomes
- Align your contributions to your department's goals
- Highlight cross-functional collaboration
- Be honest about development areas and propose an action plan

### Outcome

Year-end ratings influence annual increment percentages and bonus eligibility. Ratings are confidential between you, your manager, and HR.

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: Work From Home (WFH) Policy
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## Remote Work Policy

Citadel Group supports flexible working arrangements for eligible roles.

### Eligibility

- Permanent employees who have completed their **probation period**
- Roles that do not require a physical presence (confirmed by your department head)
- Employees with a satisfactory or above performance rating

### WFH Entitlement

- Up to **2 days per week** for eligible employees
- WFH days cannot be on **Mondays or Fridays** without prior manager approval
- Department heads may restrict WFH during peak periods or project deadlines

### How to Apply

1. Discuss with your manager and agree on a recurring WFH schedule
2. Submit a **WFH arrangement request** via **HR Services → Flexible Work**
3. HR will issue a formal confirmation within 3 business days

### WFH Requirements

- Must be reachable during core hours **(9:00 AM – 5:00 PM)**
- Must have a stable internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps)
- Must be connected to the **company VPN** when accessing internal systems
- Must attend all scheduled meetings (video on for calls with clients or leadership)

### Equipment

- Employees are responsible for their own WFH setup
- IT can loan a portable monitor or peripherals — submit an IT request under **Hardware & Devices**
- Company-issued laptops must be used for all work activities

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: Business Travel Policy and Booking Guide
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## Business Travel Policy

All business travel must be pre-approved and booked through the company's designated channels.

### Pre-Approval

1. Submit a **Travel Request** via **Group Finance → Travel & Accommodation** at least **5 business days** before travel
2. Include: destination, travel dates, purpose, and estimated costs
3. Approval is required from your manager; trips above RM 5,000 also require Finance approval

### Booking Channels

- **Flights**: Book via the corporate travel portal (link in Finance intranet) — do NOT purchase independently without prior approval
- **Hotels**: Use corporate rate hotels listed in the travel portal; max RM 350/night domestic, RM 600/night international
- **Transport**: Company-arranged ground transport for airport transfers; Grab/taxi reimbursable with receipt

### Allowances (Per Diem)

| Location | Daily Meal Allowance |
|---|---|
| Domestic (within Malaysia) | RM 80/day |
| ASEAN countries | RM 150/day |
| Outside ASEAN | RM 250/day |

### Claiming Travel Expenses

After your trip:
1. Collect all receipts (no receipt = no reimbursement for items above RM 50)
2. Submit via **Group Finance → Expense Claims** within **14 days** of returning
3. Attach flight itinerary and hotel invoice to the claim
4. Per diem allowances do not require receipts

knowledgeBaseArticle.title: Budget Planning and Cost Center Guide
knowledgeBaseArticle.content:
## Budget & Cost Center Guide

Understanding how to use cost centers ensures accurate financial reporting and smooth approval of your procurement requests.

### What is a Cost Center?

A cost center is a unique code assigned to each department or project that tracks expenditure. Every purchase requisition and expense claim must include the correct cost center code.

### Finding Your Cost Center

1. Log in to the Finance portal
2. Navigate to **My Department → Cost Center Info**
3. Your primary cost center code is displayed on your profile
4. For project-specific codes, contact your Finance Business Partner

### Common Cost Center Codes

| Department | Code |
|---|---|
| Human Resources | CC-HR-001 |
| Information Technology | CC-IT-001 |
| Group Finance | CC-FIN-001 |
| Operations | CC-OPS-001 |
| Executive Office | CC-EXEC-001 |

### Annual Budget Cycle

| Activity | Timeline |
|---|---|
| Department heads submit budget proposals | October |
| Finance review and consolidation | November |
| Management approval | December |
| Budget takes effect | 1 January |

### Budget Queries

For queries about budget availability, spending limits, or to request a budget reallocation, submit a request via **Group Finance → Budget Enquiry** and your assigned Finance Business Partner will respond within 2 business days.
